==Description==
'''Axe Throw''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Solar Eclipse Event#Solar Eclipse Season Pass|Solar Eclipse Season Pass]]. It was created by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is not looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 10 in regards to the Event Season Pass, which would cost {{SolarShard|700 Solar Shards}} or {{Robux|400}} at that rank.  The total cost to obtain the emote was {{SolarShard|4,475 Solar Shards}} or {{Robux|2,500}}.

==Trivia==
*This emote is likely based on the [[Jaxe (Solar Eclipse)|Jaxe's]] ''Axe Throw'' ability.
*This emote will make a "hit" sound when making contact with an object.
**This hit sound is taken from ''Team Fortress 2''.
*The axe can hit objects and enemies that cannot be interacted with.
